data_status: Illustrative normalized design values; not user records or exercise outcome evidence.
lettering: Original geometric lettering; no runtime font
stroke_note: Shared construction stroke; e has vertical and s has width/height optical fitting.

color_policy.strategy: One foreground across the complete name and record trace; surface-adapted monochrome production signature.
color_policy.source: Existing Reprism app accent, foreground and background tokens; light-surface colors are adapted variants.

ink.reason: Use the existing product accent across the complete signature so R and the name read as one identity.

record.reason: Keep the record in the same foreground as the frame; its real negative-space lane distinguishes it without a second tone.

type.reason: Use the same foreground as R for all six letters; continuous shape and color bind the complete name at compact header sizes.

review.target_status: Project-specific design review target, not a claim that all logos must meet WCAG text thresholds.
review.method: W3C relative luminance and (Lighter + 0.05) / (Darker + 0.05); nominal solid colors, not antialiased edge pixels.
checks: Consistent element roles across dark and light variants
Recognition in monochrome without hue-dependent meaning

color_policy.monochrome: The production strategy is monochrome: mint on dark, dark green on light, ink for one-color print, or warm white in inverse use.
color_policy.boundary: The palette comes from the product, not a universal association between green and scientific credibility.
